description: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350, with headers for breadboard)
Schottky 1 A 40 V, rail reverse-polarity block
Dual Schottky clamp per output (to +-12 V)
1 k series output resistor, 0.66 W anti-surge 1206
10 k 0.1 % 25 ppm (R1x gain set + Vb top)
49.9 k 1 % 50 ppm thin film (input series, 2 per input; calibrated)
9.09 k 1 % 50 ppm thin film (input shunt; calibrated)
Stripboard / prototype board (2-layer PCB later: 5 boards ~GBP 5 + post)
SOIC-14 to DIP adapter (OPA4172) - or TL074CN DIP (range ~+-9.5 V)
Bench supply +-12 V with current limit (or Eurorack PSU via ribbon)
